design: All114 authored template-value combinations,including cyclic boundaries. No target-based source selection or hidden prompt edits. Relation offsets define expected categorical next/predecessor/identity outputs. Candidate token probabilities and complete baselines retained even if semantic task fails. This is development material assessment,not independent natural confirmation.
operations: For each prompt,donors change only the marked variable by each fixed offset within the same template. Compare raw single-slot donor activation differences at layers2/5/8,raw full suffix patch as a counterfactual identity check,and five same-configuration SAE decoded donor differences at layer5. Reconstructed deltas preserve recipient residual,not SAE replacement. Require slot/token alignment and actual no-op/full-forward checks; do not equate source recognition or raw patch success with FCC recovery.
decision: Use baseline relation competence,actual variable-specific intervention effect and SAE preservation jointly to choose the subsequent source-variable object; do not select individual target wins or immediately train a new suite. Any further template modifications are a new explicitly exposed development attempt,not new confirmation.
